description: Odin is one of the most respected deities in Valhalla. Indeed, he and his wife are its undisputed sovereigns. Like all the other gods, he used his powers to create the Valkyries, but he notably created the first one. Many have heard of Odin’s exploits as a powerful warrior. With his spear Gungnir, he is capable of destroying any creature. However, very few know the legend of his ultimate power of “Creation”. Indeed, Odin has created a great many life forms in hope of finding one that could protect Valhalla. A fear lurks behind this seemingly laudable wish. Nothing scares this god, except an old prophecy that foretells a cataclysmic event known as Ragnarok...
fusion: Ragnarok... What should I do...? Frigg...
